remarks: Discover the Woodbridge lifestyle at 4 Windwood. Set on a cul-de-sac inside the loop, this two-story townhome pairs a flexible floor plan with a private backyard and access to the lakes, parks, and recreation that make this community so appealing. The living area welcomes you with high ceilings, a fireplace, and an open feel. An updated kitchen with solid surface countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast nook makes everyday meals and entertaining easy. Downstairs, a bedroom, den, office offers options for a home office, guest space, or potential third bedroom, with a half bath nearby.
